mainEntity.name: Will this work with the software we already use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sometimes directly, sometimes with a workaround, occasionally not at all. We check before quoting rather than after, and we will tell you when the honest answer is no.
Then the workflow changes. They are built to be edited, and we document each step in plain language so a change is a conversation rather than an excavation.

mainEntity.name: Is this going to replace someone’s job?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the businesses we work with it replaces the part of a job everybody dislikes — copying details between places and remembering to chase things.
With whatever you have redone most times this month. That is almost always the right first automation.
